description: The file defines a Java class 'SearchQueryUnique' in the package 'org.openmrs.api.db.hibernate.search'. It provides methods for performing distinct search queries that remove duplicates based on a specified unique key and support combining results from multiple queries, specifically designed for use with Hibernate Search and Lucene. It includes mechanisms for managing query joins, handling max clause limits, and efficiently retrieving unique keys and search results.

classes.name: SearchQueryUnique
classes.description: A generic helper class for executing distinct search queries that avoid duplicate results based on a specified unique key, support query joins, and manage limit constraints for Hibernate Search/Lucene.

methods.name: newQuery
methods.description: Creates a new instance of SearchQueryUnique with specified scope, search predicate, unique key, and mapper.

methods.name: searchCount
methods.description: Performs a search query to compute only the total hit count for the specified unique query.

methods.name: search
methods.description: Performs a search query returning a list of results with optional offset and limit.

methods.name: search
methods.description: Executes the search considering offset, limit, and whether to include total hit count, and returns results with total count info.

methods.name: findUniqueKeys
methods.description: Retrieves a list of unique key values from the search index up to the maximum allowed clause count.
